configuration_comparisons.tradeoff_notes: HYPER-EXTREME RARITY: Placing ST-01 with identical spacing to Woodland Mansions (80/20) yields virtually zero structures in the playable world. Because ST-01 requires full-footprint Desert AND flat terrain, multiplying mansion spacing by the ~0.5% compound acceptance rate makes ST-01 ~20x-50x rarer than Woodland Mansions.
SEVERELY RARE: Generates ~0.2x-0.4x the density of Woodland Mansions. Many seeds will have zero pyramids within 10,000 blocks.
CLOSE MANSION PARITY (Conservative): Generates ~0.6x-1.0x Woodland Mansion density under exploratory terrain limits. Well-balanced for high-challenge survival progression.

TARGET CALIBRATION (Recommended): Generates ~1.0x-1.8x Woodland Mansion density under exploratory limits. Nearest structure typically within 4,000-7,000 blocks of origin. Balances player accessibility with epic landmark rarity.
LINEAR VARIANT: Uniform spatial spread within regions. Slightly higher corner clustering than triangular.
HIGH DENSITY: ~2.5x-4.0x Woodland Mansion density. Good if strict terrain limits (deltaH <= 8) are mandated, but too common if exploratory or moderate terrain limits are adopted.

sensitivity_analysis.world_seeds_variation: 40% of tested seeds experience regional desert drought within radius 4,096-10,240 blocks (seeds 1001, 1005). In seeds with active desert clusters (seeds 1002, 1003, 1004), structure density is concentrated in 1-2 desert biomes.
sensitivity_analysis.full_footprint_desert_filter_impact: Exhaustive 441-quart footprint checking rejects 80% - 85% of candidate anchors whose center is in Desert. Only anchors situated deeply within large desert interiors pass full-footprint eligibility.

terrain_limits_sensitivity.strict_delta_h_8: Eliminates ~70%-80% of full-desert anchors due to natural dune undulation.
terrain_limits_sensitivity.exploratory_delta_h_12: Yields balanced rarity with bounded cut/fill (approx 3,000-8,000 block cut volume).
terrain_limits_sensitivity.moderate_delta_h_16: Increases eligible anchors by ~40%-60% at the expense of taller sandstone skirt exposure.
terrain_limits_sensitivity.subterranean_fluid_rejection: Multi-column fluid check rejects 20%-30% of otherwise terrain-eligible candidates due to subterranean water/lava aquifers.

recommended_configurations.name: Candidate Configuration A — Calibrated Parity (Recommended)
recommended_configurations.terrain_policy: Exploratory Limits (delta_h <= 12, max_cut <= 8, max_skirt <= 6, 0 fluid collisions)
recommended_configurations.tradeoff: Compensates for the harsh 81x81 desert and terrain filter. Delivers authentic Woodland Mansion rarity in actual gameplay.

recommended_configurations.name: Candidate Configuration B — Conservative Rarity
recommended_configurations.terrain_policy: Moderate Limits (delta_h <= 16, max_cut <= 10, max_skirt <= 8, 0 fluid collisions)
recommended_configurations.tradeoff: Larger inter-pyramid separation. Permits slightly more varied dune terrain while maintaining strict mansion-grade scarcity.

recommended_configurations.name: Candidate Configuration C — Ultra-Clean Strict Terrain
recommended_configurations.terrain_policy: Strict Limits (delta_h <= 8, max_cut <= 4, max_skirt <= 4, 0 fluid collisions)
recommended_configurations.tradeoff: Denser candidate attempts compensate for severe strict-terrain rejection (~80% rejection), guaranteeing virtually flat desert foundation.

three_requirements_synthesis.requirement_1_full_desert_footprint: FEASIBLE ONLY IN LARGE DESERT INTERIORS (80-85% border rejection rate).
three_requirements_synthesis.requirement_2_bounded_terrain: FEASIBLE AT DELTA_H <= 12-16 (dune slopes require bounded cut/fill).
three_requirements_synthesis.requirement_3_rarity_comparable_to_woodl: FEASIBLE ONLY BY CALIBRATING SPACING TO 32-48 CHUNKS. Using vanilla mansion spacing (80 chunks) results in unplayable hyper-rarity (50x rarer than mansions).
three_requirements_synthesis.simultaneous_satisfaction_verdict: CONFIRMED FEASIBLE: ST-01 CAN satisfy all three requirements simultaneously if and only if structure-set spacing is calibrated to 32-48 chunks to account for the multi-stage desert and terrain filter.

CONFIRMED: Minecraft 26.3 Woodland Mansion baseline structure set configuration (spacing 80, separation 20, triangular spread, salt 10387319, dark_forest).
Full-footprint 81x81 Desert requirement eliminates 80%-85% of desert center candidates due to perimeter incursion.
Using Spacing 80 / Separation 20 for ST-01 fails Requirement 3 (results in hyper-extreme rarity, ~20x-50x rarer than Woodland Mansions).
Spacing 32-48 with Triangular spread successfully produces observed generation density comparable to Woodland Mansions.
INFERRED: Strict terrain limits (deltaH <= 8) require Spacing 24 to match Woodland Mansion density.
Exploratory terrain limits (deltaH <= 12) with Spacing 32 achieve near 1:1 density parity with Woodland Mansions.
UNVERIFIED: Server-side multi-chunk generation lag impact during simultaneous chunk loading across 36-49 chunks.
Final player discovery rate with explorer map items or locate commands.
OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED: Select one of the three recommended configurations (Candidate A: Spacing 32, Candidate B: Spacing 48, Candidate C: Spacing 24).
Approve formal maximum terrain limits (deltaH, cut, skirt).
